summary: Webhook + idempotency design is sound. HMAC verification, replay-window, dedup-key composition, step-ordering, terminal-state guard, outbox-on-transition, logging hygiene, tx atomicity, simulate auth/ownership, and sweeper SKIP-LOCKED safety all implemented per TD. Two minor severity findings; no critical/high.

hmac_constant_time.notes: Algorithm pinned via hmac.New(sha256.New, secret); no header-driven alg trust. Hex decode error returns false.

secret_handling.evidence: config/config.go env CALLBACK_HMAC_SECRET notEmpty; handler.go stores []byte; never logged in WarnContext on mismatch.

replay_window_timestamp_skew.evidence: handler_callback.go:56 ±5min skew; RFC3339 parse with 401 on missing/invalid header.

dedup_key_composition.evidence: process_callback.go:232 sha256(intentID + '|' + providerStatus). amount, mockPaymentRef NOT in key — attacker cannot tweak field to force re-fire.

amount_check_before_terminal_guard.evidence: process_callback.go Step 2 (line 69) precedes Step 5 terminal guard. Amount-mismatch returns 409 PAYMENT_AMOUNT_MISMATCH with no dedup-row write, blocking 'tweaked-amount FAILED after SUCCEEDED' bypass.

terminal_state_guard.evidence: process_callback.go:110 TerminalStatuses[intent.Status] → 409 PAYMENT_INTENT_TERMINAL with persisted dedup row. Same providerStatus collides at Step 4 dedup lookup → cached envelope (replay).

outbox_only_on_transition.evidence: EXPIRED branch gated by emitExpiredEvent flag (default false per TD). Replay (SUCCEEDED→SUCCEEDED) returns at Step 4 before reaching outbox insert; terminal-different-status takes 409 path without outbox.

logging_hygiene.evidence: Only dedup_key, intent_id, provider_status, action, expected/got amount logged. Raw body and signature header never emitted; SIGNATURE_INVALID path logs no body. Amount-mismatch logs numeric values only (no PII).

tx_atomicity.evidence: Single tx wraps GetByIDForUpdate, dedup lookup, intent UPDATE, outbox INSERT, dedup INSERT; commit at end. Defer rollback. Succeeded/failed/expired marks all use intent.Version (optimistic lock).

callback_auth_internal_vs_public.evidence: Public POST /callback verifies HMAC; simulate handler invokes svc.Simulate → ProcessCallback in-process, never re-hitting the public endpoint with a self-generated signature. amount derived server-side (service.go:194 AmountFromCaller: intent.AmountMinor).

sweeper_skip_locked.evidence: expiry_sweeper.go uses ListExpiredIDs (FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED per TD), per-row GetByIDForUpdate + MarkExpired with optimistic version. Crash mid-batch → next tick re-locks unprocessed rows. EXPIRED emits no outbox per TD/PR-001.

owner_check_simulate.evidence: handler_simulate.go:80 intent.OwnerUserID.String() != callerSub → 403 AUTH_FORBIDDEN. JWT sub extracted from middleware-validated claims; empty sub also rejected.

findings.title: Amount-mismatch log includes both expected and got amounts
findings.description: slog.WarnContext logs expected and got at WARN. Numeric only (no PII), but in production this could allow log-mining to enumerate intent amounts if WARN is shipped to a less-trusted aggregator. Acceptable for MVP; revisit when log routing is finalized.
findings.recommendation: Either DEBUG-level the amounts, or log only intent_id + 'AMOUNT_MISMATCH' tag and rely on stored intent for forensic lookup.

findings.title: Signature header length not pre-validated before hex decode
findings.description: VerifyHMACSignature returns false on hex decode error before reaching ConstantTimeCompare — a malformed-hex path is technically distinguishable from a wrong-MAC path by timing (no MAC compute on the fastest path). Practical impact is nil because the secret never appears in the malformed branch, but a strict reading of constant-time policy prefers compute-then-compare regardless.
findings.recommendation: Optional: always compute the MAC, then ConstantTimeCompare against a zero-buffer when hex decode fails. Cosmetic.

simplify_notes: service.go:135 GetIntentByID inlines the SELECT instead of using IntentStorage; consider adding GetByID to access.IntentStorage for consistency. Minor; not security.
handler.go:38 bindRawJSON wraps json.Unmarshal with no extra logic — inline is fine. Keep as-is for symmetry with future validators.
